entities.summary: Isko Daseni is a Georgian-Yazidi politician and jurist who has served as a Member of the Parliament of Georgia since 18 November 2016. He is a member of the ruling Georgian Dream-Democratic Georgia party and has been elected to the 9th, 10th, and 11th parliament.
